title: Super Easy Interface, Great Community
review: Super easy to use, workouts easy to replace/add in the gym. Great interface, timer tracks workout length. Small but fantastic community for engagement.

title: Absolutely great app, just 1 little flaw
review: Easily functional, gets job done even with free option. One time purchase for advanced features. Beginner friendly (shows exercise motions). Can create own exercises.

title: Best workout app imaginable
review: Used BodySpace for years, switched to Hevy. Bought lifetime membership (PLEASE don't remove this option, value is unbelievable). Tracks every lift effortlessly, great graphs.

title: Best workout tracking app I've tried
review: Favorite workout tracking app, tried many including Strong. Can label drop sets, failure sets, supersets easily. History, graphs of stats.

title: Finally found the right fitness app
review: Downloaded almost every workout app. Most had 3-day free trials, pro too expensive. Hevy stands out. (workout journal replacement)

title: Best weight training app out there
review: Was using Gymverse, switched. Wanted: data sync iPhone/iPad, ease of use, affordability. Hevy checked all boxes.

title: Great Logging and Great for Beginners
review: Logging workouts, rarely any problem finding workouts. See form, how-to section. Pro version $2/month - extremely cheap.

title: Almost perfect but missing a major one
review: Great simple UI, available on Apple devices + Apple Watch complications. Better than alternatives. But not that far ahead - others could catch up. (senior user, late 40s)

title: Enough to be great
review: Came from Fitbod (3 years). Hevy offers everything Fitbod wouldn't fix. Track everything, community, make own exercises. Very responsive devs.

title: Kept Me Accountable
review: Using since January. Reddit promo half off year. Syncs with watch, input weight/reps on watch or phone. Supplies workouts for different splits so no need for trainer.
